label: The source asserts that a possible beginning C of all contingent things entails a possible event…
paraphrase: The source asserts that a possible beginning C of all contingent things entails a possible event C* changing from no contingent things to some. Its note makes all nonrigid: C* is the first occurrence of some contingent things with none previously existing, not a fixed collection of particular individuals across worlds. These before/after states belong to the event identity.
